criteria.requirement: Implement chardet.transcode.transcode_bytes(data, target_encoding, *, source_encoding=None). Use the explicit source codec or actual detection result, require a supported codec and strict full-payload decoding/encoding with no replacement or character loss. Return independent output bytes, canonical source/target names, original detection facts when used and validated byte count. Target codec explicitly controls BOM, empty auto-detection must request a source, unrepresentable target text and malformed source bytes fail, and input buffers remain unchanged. Do not imply autodetected semantic accuracy.
必须交付授权源码、能在原版失败的公开回归和中文兼容说明；所有冻结原生回归通过。

comparison: 依据真实程序行为接受等价实现，不按参考文本或篇幅评分。
